IDENT.title: Adaptive task planning and coordination in multi-agent manufacturing systems using large language models

A_DEFINITION__agent_definition_verbatim.value: PA: 'A PA manages the completion of production tasks for a part in the system related to its associated physical product [44]'; RA manages a specific resource [43]. MAS characterized by autonomy, reactivity, pro-activeness, social ability [8].
A_DEFINITION__agent_definition_verbatim.evidence_quote: A PA manages the completion of production tasks for a part in the system related to its associated physical product [44].

A_DEFINITION__definition_source.evidence_quote: An RA manages a specific manufacturing resource (e.g., machine or robot) to execute tasks assigned by PAs [43].

A_DEFINITION__agent_term_used.evidence_quote: The system includes two types of agents, which are PAs and RAs.

A_DEFINITION__agent_entity_types.evidence_quote: RAs were initialized for three 3D printers and two robotic arms.

B_ARCHITECTURE__has_knowledge_base.evidence_quote: integrated into a comprehensive internal knowledge base, , maintained by each agent.

B_ARCHITECTURE__kb_representation.evidence_quote: Each agent constructs a semantic embedding vector store

B_ARCHITECTURE__decision_mechanism.evidence_quote: an LLM-only method versus a combined LLM and structured ranking method using Eq. (7).

B_ARCHITECTURE__decision_scalability_dis.evidence_quote: we examined its scalability by evaluating how planning accuracy and efficiency change as the number of parts increases.

B_ARCHITECTURE__has_communication_manage.evidence_quote: context-specific message placed into the agent’s inbox, used for agent-to-agent communication during operation

C_MEMORY__memory_historical.evidence_quote: For RAs, knowledge base  contains resource-related information such as material specifications, resource manuals, and standard operating procedures.

C_MEMORY__memory_historical_description.value: Predefined capabilities, parameters and documentation embedded in vector stores; plan state saved during execution.
C_MEMORY__memory_historical_description.evidence_quote: stores predefined capabilities and parameters with manufacturing documentations for each agent

C_MEMORY__memory_realtime.evidence_quote: RAs communicate their current operational status to PAs for runtime task coordination.

C_MEMORY__memory_scope.evidence_quote: enable each agent to retrieve knowledge for its own tasks

C_MEMORY__memory_persists_across_episode.evidence_quote: The resulting embedding store is then stored with SaveStore, indexed by the agent identifier

C_MEMORY__memory_requirements_stated.evidence_quote: knowledge base  provides parameters and constraints that can be retrieved without predefined mappings

D_COMMUNICATION__comm_protocol.evidence_quote: A structured message 𝑚𝑗 sent from agent 𝐴𝑖 (e.g., a PA) to agent 𝐴𝑗 (e.g., an RA) contains 𝑚𝑗= (𝑜, 𝛿, 𝜅)

D_COMMUNICATION__negotiation_mechanism.evidence_quote: a PA broadcast a capability query 𝑚𝑗 to multiple RAs.

D_COMMUNICATION__comm_topology.evidence_quote: self-communication, agent-to-agent communication, and agent-to-multiple-agents communication

E_LEARNING__learning_present.evidence_quote: Fine-tuned LLMs were adapted using Low Rank Adaptation Method (LoRA) [67] on a set of manufacturing question–answer examples.

E_LEARNING__learning_type.evidence_quote: Agents in the MAS combine predefined capabilities with dynamically retrieved manufacturing knowledge using a Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG)

E_LEARNING__explores_beyond_predefined_e.evidence_quote: During manufacturing execution, RAs dynamically retrieve relevant manufacturing documentation to discover additional capabilities

E_LEARNING__learning_quality_measured.evidence_quote: increasing accuracy from 25% to 48% for Gemma-2-9B and from 34% to 60% for LLaMA-3.1-8B

E_LEARNING__learning_quality_metric.value: Accuracy (%) of match functions, assign parameters, match constraints, extract parameter keys, assign resources; latency
E_LEARNING__learning_quality_metric.evidence_quote: Accuracy of reasoning sub-tasks across model and embedding configurations

E_LEARNING__uses_foundation_model.evidence_quote: GPT-4o combined with text-embedding-3-large is used as the default configuration

E_LEARNING__foundation_model_role.evidence_quote: Product requirement parsing; task planning; function matching; constraint reasoning; resource selection

E_LEARNING__foundation_model_limitations.value: Selects second-highest value via textual not numerical reasoning; retrieves textually similar but irrelevant passages; negation errors (-no-wipe); output truncation/hallucination with long prompts; high latency; formatting errors in small models; assigned robot to printing.
E_LEARNING__foundation_model_limitations.evidence_quote: the LLM occasionally selects the second-highest value because it relies on textual interpretation rather than evaluating the numerical comparison

G_VALIDATION_METRICS__validation_level.evidence_quote: The study uses a physical manufacturing testbed, shown in Fig. 9(a), to demonstrate the framework’s feasibility

G_VALIDATION_METRICS__metrics_reported.evidence_quote: Comparison of plan time and accuracy between Case 1 and Case 2 across increasing number of parts.

G_VALIDATION_METRICS__baseline_compared_.evidence_quote: an LLM-only method versus a combined LLM and structured ranking method using Eq. (7).

G_VALIDATION_METRICS__disruption_types_h.evidence_quote: new or modified product requirements are introduced during operation

G_VALIDATION_METRICS__system_scale.evidence_quote: each iteration comprised nine parts and five tasks, yielding 450 tasks per case

G_VALIDATION_METRICS__application_domain.evidence_quote: evaluated using an assembly task board testbed across three case studies

I_DELTA_VS_REFERENCE__features_common_wi.evidence_quote: PAs dynamically plan and expand task phases, match product requirements to RA capabilities, delegate tasks, and coordinate execution with RAs.

I_DELTA_VS_REFERENCE__features_divergent.value: Replaces model-based formal representation with LLM reasoning plus RAG over vector-store documentation; discovers unmodeled capabilities/parameters at runtime; adds HITL validation; DAG task plans.
I_DELTA_VS_REFERENCE__features_divergent.evidence_quote: This approach enables runtime generation of process plans and identification of available capabilities without relying on predefined rules.

I_DELTA_VS_REFERENCE__essential_componen.value: Claims all three communication strategies are needed for capability exploration.
I_DELTA_VS_REFERENCE__essential_componen.evidence_quote: Using fewer strategies (e.g., only self and agent-to-agent) would exclude the ability to dynamically explore capabilities on the shop floor.

I_DELTA_VS_REFERENCE__cites_reference_fr.evidence_quote: A PA manages the completion of production tasks for a part in the system related to its associated physical product [44].
